description: This PHP class implements a value formatter for PayGrade IDs, transforming them into human-readable PayGrade names within the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes dependency injection to access the PayGrade service and retrieves the name corresponding to a given PayGrade ID.

classes.name: FormatWithPayGradeId
classes.description: A class that implements the ValueFormatter interface to convert PayGrade IDs into their corresponding PayGrade names.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGrade by ID using the PayGrade service and returns its name if found; otherwise returns null.
